limitations: Reference target is 2026-09-19 America/New_York; captures retain actual 2026-09-20 UTC timestamps. No pre-September20UTC retrieval or authenticated historical vendor release date is claimed.
Mutable public documentation captured on the target NewYork calendar date; no Console implementation, exhaustive equivalence or executable acceptance established.
Pipeline, streaming, external-compute and media reference capabilities require independent owner-bound correctness, security and performance acceptance; all additions remain planned.
Snapshot reads, successful schedule dispatch, completed job outputs and whole-pipeline atomic success are distinct. Partial jobs and transactionless media writes require explicit durable recovery.
Exactly-once state mutation applies to the documented selected stream mode and per-key ordering; it does not prove end-to-end delivery or bit-identical event-time replay.

Computational checkpoint materialization is distinct from durable streaming state/offset recovery. Vendor destructive replay and optional input-retention semantics do not authorize Console acknowledged-state loss.

External Pipeline Builder supports Databricks/Snowflake with same-source virtual tables and a limited transform set; Python compute pushdown has a different matrix. BYOC examples with floating image tags do not waive Console immutable image/dependency requirements.

Pipeline rollback is marked planned deprecation after November30 without an explicit year in the captured notice; dataset rollback is the named successor, but dependency-wide recovery remains required by Console.

Media soft deletion leaves directly linked content accessible; retention is a separate irreversible removal path. Virtual media may become stale after source updates/deletions and transformed outputs may be copied into managed storage.
Media set storage and XLSX conversion do not satisfy native collaborative sheet formulas, concurrency or Office-file round-trip requirements.
Public media documentation includes embeddings, VLM and AIP references; generative/AIP runtime capabilities remain outside Console and are not admitted by these snapshots.
